title: Bakuhatsu — Doctrine of Detonation
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Explosion classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Explosion jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Increase Damage Given and a controlled +2 Damage payoff (the charge and the detonation: Charge 4 Explosion and Howitzer Crash self buffs, which compound, and the three Explosion area attacks)
emphasis.secondary: Afterburn (the mark Charge 4 Explosion leaves on its target) and Increase Damage Taken (the same cast's exposure, Ground Zero's setup)
emphasis.rationale: Three of the eight supported rows are Explosion Damage on 60 AP area attacks (Kinetic Nova 50, Inferno Cataclysm and Howitzer Crash 40 EP), so the detonation keeps a burst route, held to the director pattern: Shaped Charge sets up +3% exposure and Ground Zero pays off with +2 Damage (Nova 50 → 52, the 40 rows 42). Primed Fuse answers "How do I make my detonations land harder: charge myself or aim the charge?" with Critical Mass (both compounding self buffs 43%) and Ground Zero. Smoke and Shrapnel answers "How do I win what the blast leaves behind: shelter in the smoke or leave the shrapnel burning?" with Siege Battery (Blast Shield 45%) and Chain Reaction (Afterburn 45%). The kit has no heal, lifesteal, reflect or Decrease Damage Given rows, so no sustain or suppression route is invented.

nodes.name: Primed Fuse
nodes.flavor: Every detonation begins as a held breath and a lit fuse.
nodes.coverage_note: Charge 4 Explosion and Howitzer Crash self buffs 35 → 37%; Charge 4 Explosion exposure 35 → 37% (3 rows).

nodes.name: Shaped Charge
nodes.flavor: The blast is not larger; it is aimed.
nodes.coverage_note: Aims the charge: Charge 4 Explosion exposure 37 → 40% with Primed Fuse (single target, range 4, 40 AP, live the two rounds after the cast); Earth, Explosion, Lightning and element-less hits on it, all three Explosion attacks included, land ×1.40.

nodes.name: Ground Zero
nodes.flavor: Where the charge lands, the map is redrawn.
nodes.coverage_note: Burst payoff: Kinetic Nova 50 → 52 EP (past the 50 Nuke tier; director review), Inferno Cataclysm and Howitzer Crash 40 → 42 EP (still Normal) on every cast, charge round or not.

nodes.name: Powder Keg
nodes.flavor: The body is a magazine; patience is the match.
nodes.coverage_note: Commits to the charge: both self buffs 37 → 39% with Primed Fuse, each live the two rounds after its cast (×1.39 × 1.39 ≈ ×1.93 with both up).

nodes.name: Critical Mass
nodes.flavor: Pack enough charge into one body and the body becomes the bomb.
nodes.coverage_note: Sustained amplification: both self buffs 35 → 43% on the full route (+8%); with both live, every caster hit that is element-less or uses the highest offence stat lands ×1.43 × 1.43 ≈ ×2.04 (×1.82 unmodified).

nodes.name: Smoke and Shrapnel
nodes.flavor: The blast is over. Its cloud and its fragments are not.
nodes.coverage_note: Blast Shield Decrease Damage Taken 35 → 37% (caster-only self buff, 2 rounds per 40 AP cast); Charge 4 Explosion Afterburn 35 → 37% (2 rows).

nodes.name: Hardened Casing
nodes.flavor: Debris packs into a wall that holds the second time, too.
nodes.coverage_note: Blast Shield Decrease Damage Taken 37 → 40% with Smoke and Shrapnel (one caster-only row).

nodes.name: Siege Battery
nodes.flavor: Dug in behind the blast wall, the battery keeps firing.
nodes.coverage_note: Fortress: Blast Shield 35 → 45% on the full route (+10%), incoming hits ×0.55 (×0.65 unmodified); both self buffs +2% (37%, 39% with Primed Fuse).

nodes.name: Slow Burn
nodes.flavor: Shrapnel lodges hot and stays hot.
nodes.coverage_note: Marks the target: Charge 4 Explosion Afterburn 37 → 40% with Smoke and Shrapnel (single target, range 4, 40 AP, live the two rounds after the cast).

nodes.name: Chain Reaction
nodes.flavor: One blast primes the next. Nothing lands only once.
nodes.coverage_note: Mark: Charge 4 Explosion Afterburn 35 → 45% on the full route (+10%) from one 40 AP cast; for the two rounds after it, every non-pierce hit on the target, allies' included, adds 45% Afterburn.

examples.name: Ground Zero
examples.rationale: Every Kinetic Nova lands at 52 EP and every Inferno Cataclysm and Howitzer Crash at 42 EP (Ground Zero +2), with no charge round needed. Charge 4 Explosion's exposure reaches 40% (Primed Fuse +2%, Shaped Charge +3%), so a Nova on the exposed target lands ×1.40 before the bloodline passive. Powder Keg is the offensive fourth: after Charge 4 Explosion and Howitzer Crash in one 100 AP round both self buffs are 39%, and a 52 EP Nova on the exposed target lands ×1.39 × 1.39 × 1.40 ≈ ×2.70. Smoke and Shrapnel (Blast Shield 37%, Afterburn 37%) is the safer fourth.

examples.name: Critical Mass
examples.rationale: Both self buffs reach 43% (Primed Fuse +2%, Powder Keg +2%, Critical Mass +4%). Cast Charge 4 Explosion and Howitzer Crash in one 100 AP round; in the next two rounds every Kinetic Nova, Inferno Cataclysm or other caster hit that is element-less or uses the highest offence stat lands ×1.43 × 1.43 ≈ ×2.04 on everything it hits, weapons and off-kit jutsu included, and the bloodline passive multiplies last. Shaped Charge is the offensive fourth (exposure 40%: ×2.04 × 1.40 ≈ ×2.86 on the charged target); Smoke and Shrapnel (Blast Shield 37%, Afterburn 37%) is the safe one.

examples.name: Chain Reaction
examples.rationale: One 40 AP Charge 4 Explosion marks its target for two rounds: Afterburn 45% (Smoke and Shrapnel +2%, Slow Burn +3%, Chain Reaction +5%), so every non-pierce hit on the mark, from the caster or allies, adds 45% Afterburn. Primed Fuse is the offensive fourth: the same cast's exposure reaches 37% and both self buffs 37%, so an ally's Earth, Explosion, Lightning or element-less hit on the mark comes to ×1.37 × 1.45 ≈ ×1.99. Hardened Casing (Blast Shield 40%) is the defensive one.

examples.name: Siege Battery
examples.rationale: Blast Shield's reduction reaches 45% on the caster for the two rounds after each 40 AP cast (incoming hits ×0.55; allies do not receive it). Primed Fuse is the fourth that keeps the battery firing: with Siege Battery's +2% both self buffs reach 39% and the exposure 37%, so the shielded caster still fires a charged Nova (×1.39 × 1.39 ≈ ×1.93 with both buffs up). Slow Burn (Afterburn 40%) is the alternative fourth for a bunker that still burns.

design_notes: 2026-10-04 rebalance, roster pass (BALANCE_REVIEW_METHOD.md; corrected Director precedent). The first pass removed the Burst branch only to keep Kinetic Nova at 50, shrinking the tree to eight nodes with Primed Fuse universal. This pass restores it as the director pattern: Shaped Charge is now a +3% Increase Damage Taken setup (was +2 Damage) and Ground Zero a +2 Damage payoff (was +3), so the only Damage total is +2 (pre-batch +5: Nova 55, the 40 rows 45). The pre-batch wiring returns with it: Smoke and Shrapnel (+2% Decrease Damage Taken, +2% Afterburn; the first pass's Eye of the Blast) roots the fortress and the mark, and Slow Burn returns under it at +3% Afterburn (first pass +5%). Kept from the first pass: Powder Keg +2% and Critical Mass +4% Increase Damage Given (pre-batch +3% and +5%). Chain Reaction keeps its +5% Afterburn and drops its pre-batch +3% Increase Damage Taken (final review): on the same Charge 4 Explosion cast as the burn it took the mark to exposure 40% / Afterburn 45% with Primed Fuse (≈ ×2.03), and it raised the same exposure row as Shaped Charge's setup. Unchanged: Primed Fuse, Hardened Casing, Siege Battery.

Increase Damage Given is held at +8%, not +10%: its two self buffs compound when both are live, so +8% takes the double-buff window from ×1.82 to ×2.04; +10% would reach ×2.10. Exposure is one row, +5% at most (Primed Fuse plus Shaped Charge, the only Hidden or Advanced Art that raises it). Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +8%, Increase Damage Taken +5%, Afterburn +10%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Damage +2.

Filters (§3): both Increase Damage Given rows list the Highest stat and no element, so they match every element-less hit of any stat type and the caster's highest-stat elemental hits, all three Explosion attacks included. The exposure lists Earth, Explosion, Lightning and None; Afterburn and Blast Shield's row list all four stat types and no element. The bloodline Increase Damage Given passive (25% + 0.15 per level; Lightning, Earth, Explosion, None) multiplies last; the Earth-only 15% Decrease Damage Taken passive is separate from Blast Shield's row.

Delivery (§3b, §4b): every jutsu has cooldown 7. The three Damage casts cost 60 AP (Inferno Cataclysm spiral around the caster, Kinetic Nova circle on a target, Howitzer Crash circle on empty ground that moves the caster) and are ENEMIES-only. Charge 4 Explosion (40 AP, single target, range 4) carries the self buff, the exposure and the Afterburn; Howitzer Crash carries the second self buff; Blast Shield (40 AP) the reduction. SELF rows land on the caster at cast. Every buff and debuff is live only in the two rounds after its cast, so neither self buff raises its own jutsu's hit.

Fourth purchases: Ground Zero takes Powder Keg (self buffs 39%) or Smoke and Shrapnel; Critical Mass takes Shaped Charge (exposure 40%) or Smoke and Shrapnel; Chain Reaction takes Primed Fuse (self buffs 37%, exposure 37%: an ally's hit on the mark ×1.37 × 1.45 ≈ ×1.99) or Hardened Casing; Siege Battery takes Primed Fuse (self buffs 39%) or Slow Burn (Afterburn 40%). Shaped Charge cannot join Chain Reaction (5 BP), so no build stacks the setup onto the mark. The two all-offense Primed Fuse builds share three nodes and differ in the capstone: in the double-buff window a Nova on the exposed target comes to 50 × 2.86 ≈ 143 with Critical Mass and 52 × 2.70 ≈ 141 with Ground Zero, so Critical Mass wins whenever the charge round is paid (and on weapons, basic attacks and off-kit hits), Ground Zero whenever it is not (52 against 50, 42 against 40). No fourth makes a route automatic.
risks: Damage tier: Ground Zero lifts Kinetic Nova 50 → 52, past the 50 Nuke tier (above_nuke_rationale; director precedent RUL-2026-10-04-001/-002). Inferno Cataclysm and Howitzer Crash 40 → 42 stay Normal.

Classification: Explosion is shared with Bakuhatsu Suru Nendo (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). The three Damage rows and the exposure row carry Explosion; both self buffs, the Afterburn row and Blast Shield's row need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver, and Blast Shield (no Explosion row) also needs an authored classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Explosion coverage is unverified.

Reach: the self buffs multiply every matching caster hit in their window, on every target an area attack catches, plus weapons, basic attacks and off-kit jutsu; the exposure and Afterburn raise allies' hits on the mark. Blast Shield's reduction is caster-only.

Charge 4 Explosion concentration: one 40 AP cast can carry three enhanced rows (Chain Reaction with Primed Fuse: self buff 37%, exposure 37%, Afterburn 45%; Critical Mass with Shaped Charge: self buff 43%, exposure 40%). Afterburn per hit is capped at 60% of the hit, so 45% leaves 15 points for other Afterburn sources.

Friendly fire: the Damage rows are ENEMIES-only, so +2 Damage never reaches allies. Charge 4 Explosion may be aimed at an ally (OTHER_USER); its enhanced exposure and Afterburn then land on the ally while the self buff stays on the caster. Kinetic Nova's wound (ally hazard) and Blast Shield's barrier (enemy hazard) are unsupported and untouched.
Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. No combat simulation was performed.

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Explosion classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Explosion jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

foundation_sentences.01: How do I make my detonations land harder: charge myself or aim the charge?
foundation_sentences.05: How do I win what the blast leaves behind: shelter in the smoke or leave the shrapnel burning?

route_identities.03: burst: exposure set up, controlled raw-Damage payoff on every area cast
route_identities.10: sustained amplification: both self buffs charged, every hit in the window lands harder
route_identities.09: mark: Afterburn on one target, paid out by every hit from the party

design_review.director_review: Ground Zero's +2 Damage lifts Kinetic Nova 50 → 52, past the 50 Nuke tier, as the controlled payoff of the Shaped Charge exposure setup (Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura precedent, RUL-2026-10-04-001/-002); confirm it for this kit.
concerns: Chain Reaction with Primed Fuse puts exposure 37% beside Afterburn 45% on one 40 AP cast (an ally's hit on the mark ×1.37 × 1.45 ≈ ×1.99), level with Light of Dead Stars (×1.99) and under Consuming Malice's ×2.02. Chain Reaction dropped its pre-batch +3% Increase Damage Taken (40% / 45%, ≈ ×2.03), so the exposure row now belongs to Shaped Charge alone and the burst setup never reaches the mark (5 BP).
Critical Mass with Shaped Charge is the strongest solo build on the charged target (×2.04 × 1.40 ≈ ×2.86); Ground Zero with Powder Keg is within 2% on a Nova in that window and ahead outside it.
Every amplified row except the three Damage rows and the exposure depends on the proposed jutsu-classification resolver.

above_nuke_rationale: Fable proposal following the director precedent of RUL-2026-10-04-001 (Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Reaper's Embrace 50 → 52) and RUL-2026-10-04-002 (Shakunetsu Sakura, Sakura-ame 50 → 52): Ground Zero's +2 Damage is the controlled payoff of the Shaped Charge exposure setup and lifts Kinetic Nova 50 → 52, past the 50 Nuke tier; Inferno Cataclysm and Howitzer Crash go 40 → 42 and stay Normal. No legal allocation adds more than +2 Damage. Pending director review.
